name: YtDlp
description: YouTube indexer and downloader for Lidarr, powered by an existing yt-dlp installation. Downloads single tracks and playlists, optionally re-encodes to mp3/aac/opus/vorbis and trims non-music parts via SponsorBlock. Downloads are serialized with a configurable delay between them.
author: Lidarr.Plugin.YtDlp
